# Portable skill

Read the file the user names, then write a summary of it.
Edit the draft until each sentence says one thing. Write it plainly.
Task: triage the open issues. Grep the logs for errors if there are any.

## Skill overview

Agent Skills work in any agent tool. Ask the user before deleting anything.
A git pre-commit hook may reject the commit; fix the cause and retry.
Match the output style of the existing reports.
